text:
Rae K.: Quick kickoff for the 'Benchmark Brief' social push after next week's webinar. Objective: drive replay views + collect config requests. Needs: LinkedIn thread, 2 X posts (AM/PM), hero image, 30s clip, and SDR seed rules. Who can take which piece?
Owen L.: I can run scheduling and SDR routing. Recommend: X AM (metric), X PM (customer quote), LinkedIn thread midday that expands on the benchmarks. Also propose a tiny A/B on the LinkedIn opener.
Sana B.: I'll take copy. Tone: technical but readable. Drafts:
Variant 1: "Reduced inference cost 34% and held p95 <160ms. Replay + configs: [link]"
Variant 2: "They cut infra spend and shipped faster 12 Watch the replay. [link]"
Owen L.: We'll A/B Variant1/Variant2 on LinkedIn openers; X AM=Variant1, X PM=Variant2.
Theo J.: Design asks: hero 1200x628 PNG, 1:1 carousel (4 cards), 30s mp4 16:9. Need raw slides and hi-res screenshots. Upload ETA?
Sana B.: Clip timestamps: 00:04 intro, 00:12 batching note, 00:20 quant/kv-cache callout, 00:26 cost before/after.
Rae K.: SDR seedlist = webinar viewers (auto), replay clickers (UTM), trials with API usage in last 14d, named accounts. Route enterprise leads (ARR>10k) to AE queue. Owen, can you implement?
Owen L.: Yes. Rules: viewers->SDR-General, replay_clicks+active_trials->SDR-Adv, named+ARR>10k->AE-queue. I'll add CRM tags and post to #sales-inbound. UTM: utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_linkedin&utm_campaign=benchmark_brief_q2 (use exact string).
post-bot: Scheduled: X AM 2026-04-20T08:30Z (metric), X PM 2026-04-20T17:30Z (quote), LinkedIn thread 2026-04-20T11:00Z. No conflicts.
Theo J.: Uploaded hero draft -> https://drive.example/benchmark/hero_draft.png. Feedback: make cost delta color pop and include logo safe zone. Will push v2 by EOD.
Rae K.: Please add a pinned reply on X: "Want the config + test scripts? DM or sign up for the replay." That helps funnel infra leads. Owen will brief SDRs to monitor DMs.
Sana B.: Draft LinkedIn thread opener for review: "How we cut per-inference spend without trading latency. TL;DR: batching + KV cache + tuned kernels. Replay + configs: [link]"
Owen L.: Approve to schedule once assets locked. I'll monitor engagement first 45 minutes and flag hot leads.
Rae K.: Owners: Sana(copy), Theo(design/video), Owen(schedule+routing), Rae(campaign). Check back here when assets are uploaded. :sparkles:
